basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 24-year-old gaming enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I recently graduated with a degree in Digital Marketing and currently work as a freelance graphic designer. I'm a big fan of open-world games like Genshin Impact and The Sims. I usually play in the evenings after work, from around 7 PM to midnight. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new games and participating in online forums. My dislikes include negativity and overly competitive environments. I'm still getting used to Reddit but enjoying the diversity of discussions here.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly revolves around digital design and marketing, which I learned through my university education and various online courses. I've always been drawn to technology and gaming, teaching myself about the latest software through YouTube and online communities.
